title.en: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)
title.hi: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

definition.en: UNESCO is a specialized agency of the United Nations aimed at promoting world peace and security through international cooperation in education, sciences, and culture.
definition.hi: UNESCO is a specialized agency of the United Nations aimed at promoting world peace and security through international cooperation in education, sciences, and culture.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, understanding UNESCO is vital for analyzing international cooperation in human capital development and cultural economics. It provides a framework for how global standards influence national policies in education and heritage conservation, which are critical components of socio-economic development.
